shortDescription: Motiva, Exxon Mobil NYSE:XOM and TotalEnergies EURONEXT:TTE are maintaining planned production at their East Texas refineries as Tropical Storm Edouard nears landfall later on Tuesday close to those three U.S. Gulf Coast plants, said people familiar with operations at the refineries.Both the Exxon…

children: are maintaining planned production at their East Texas refineries as Tropical Storm Edouard nears landfall later on Tuesday close to those three U.S. Gulf Coast plants, said people familiar with operations at the refineries.

Both the Exxon Beaumont refinery and the TotalEnergies Port Arthur refinery told contractors to stay home on Tuesday or sent them home Tuesday morning while keeping the full compliment of employees on hand, the sources said.
